issues.claim: "What happens to a Pod and its IP address when the container crashes or another version of the image is rolled out?"; "Clients do not need the IP addresses of the Pods, which change on every restart and rollout."
issues.problem: A container crash is handled by the kubelet restarting the container inside the same Pod, so the Pod IP does not change. The IP changes only when the Pod is replaced (rollout, eviction, node loss). The Pods page excerpt itself says that restarting a container is not restarting a Pod. The hint and the "change on every restart" wording would teach juniors that a crash changes the IP. The hint is also built on that wrong premise.
issues.suggestedFix: Hint: "What happens to the IP address of a Pod when it is deleted and replaced, for example during a rollout or after a node failure?" Answer, Service bullet: "...Pods, whose IP addresses change whenever a Pod is replaced (rollout, eviction, node loss)". Update the RU text the same way.
